name: SikaFiber® PPM 48/19
tagline: Blended Polyolefin Macro/Micro – synthetic fibres designed to enhance the distribution and performance of fibre reinforcement
summary: SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 is a blend of Macro Structural Synthetic Fibres and Micro Monofilament Fibres which are designed to an optimum gradation. This engineered combination of macro/micro fibres provides improved interfacial bonding and flexural toughness efficiency.
metaDescription: SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 is a blend of Macro Structural Synthetic Fibres and Micro Monofilament Fibres which are designed to an optimum gradation. This engineered combination of macro/micro fibres provides improved interfacial bonding and flexural toughness efficiency.
attributes: Requires no minimum amount of concrete cover
It is always placed in compliance with the codes
Safer and easier than traditional reinforcement
SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 concrete can be pumped, sprayed or placed using conventional equipment.
usage: Control and reduce plastic shrinkage cracking
advantages: Requires no minimum amount of concrete cover

Safer and easier than traditional reinforcement
SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 concrete can be pumped, sprayed or placed using conventional equipment.
packaging: SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 is packed in 2.3kg boxes consisting of 2kg of macro fibre component and a biodegradable bag with 0.3kg of micro fibre. Each box is designed for fast dispersion within the concrete mix. SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 can be packed on pallets or most other combinations if required.

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: Macro fibre complies with EN 14489-2 Class 2 and micro with Class 1a. SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 meets the requirements of ASTM C1116 Type III.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text: SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 is compatible with all Sika Concrete admixtures and additives.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text: The typical dose rate for SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 is 2.3 kg per m3. Higher dose rates up 6.9 kg per m3 can be used as the performance requirements dictate.
